title.en: A small AI learns to tune analog circuits
title.zh: 小模型学会调校模拟电路

summary.en: MIT’s November23 report describes a locally deployable four-billion-parameter model approaching a much larger model on bounded circuit-simulation tasks. Training resources and commercial-process transfer reveal where the advance still needs work.
summary.zh: MIT11月23日报道，四十亿参数本地模型在限定电路仿真任务上接近大型模型。训练资源与商业工艺迁移结果，也显出这项进展的边界。

title.en: Three confirmed polio cases and a wider signal in Syria
title.zh: 叙利亚三例确诊脊灰背后的传播信号

summary.en: WHO’s November23 report separates three confirmed paralytic cases from twelve later paralysis reports still being investigated. The distinction helps explain vaccine-derived transmission and why surveillance and vaccination need to work together.
summary.zh: 世卫组织11月23日报告将三例确诊麻痹型脊灰，与仍在调查的十二例后续急性弛缓性麻痹报告分开。这一区别，也解释了疫苗衍生病毒、监测与接种之间的关系。
